fullTitle: Diagnosis and Management of Childhood Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome
citation: Marcus CL, Brooks LJ, Draper KA, et al. Diagnosis and Management of Childhood Obstructive Sleep Apnea Syndrome. Pediatrics. 2012;130(3):576-584.
libraryStatus: Exact official bibliographic identity verified from the American Academy of Pediatrics publication site on 2026-08-07. No exact Guild Drive full-text holding was verified during this audit.
bestFor: Historical/applicable pediatric OSA recognition, diagnostic evaluation, treatment-option awareness, and follow-up context for uncomplicated childhood OSA.
authorityBoundary: Use this 2012 AAP guideline as older/applicable pediatric OSA guidance, not as a scoring manual or a universal pediatric OSA rule source. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 controls scoring and technical definitions; ICSD-3-TR controls current diagnostic classification; current AASM pediatric guidance controls newer sleep-testing procedures. Its scope is uncomplicated childhood OSA in primary care and should not be generalized to all complex pediatric sleep-disordered breathing.
copyrightUse: Use citation, public scope/topic identity, original Sleep Pathways Guild summaries, and learning objectives only. Do not reproduce recommendation wording, tables, algorithms, figures, or substantial protected passages.
